questions.questionTextEn:
Consider the boundary value problem:
$$\frac{d^2 y}{dx^2} + \lambda y = 0, \quad y(0) = 0, \quad y(\pi) = 0$$
The eigenvalue $\lambda$ corresponding to the second lowest non-trivial eigenfunction (i.e. $n = 2$) is ______ (answer in integer).
questions.explanationEn:
The general solution for $\lambda > 0$ with $y(0) = 0$ is:
$$y(x) = A \sin(\sqrt{\lambda} x)$$
Applying the boundary condition at $x = \pi$:
$$y(\pi) = A \sin(\sqrt{\lambda} \pi) = 0$$
For non-trivial solutions ($A \ne 0$):
$$\sqrt{\lambda} \pi = n \pi \implies \lambda_n = n^2 \quad (n = 1, 2, 3, \dots)$$
For the second lowest eigenfunction, $n = 2$:
$$\lambda_2 = 2^2 = 4$$
Thus, the integer answer is 4.
questions.questionTextHi:
सीमांत मान समस्या पर विचार कीजिए:
$$\frac{d^2 y}{dx^2} + \lambda y = 0, \quad y(0) = 0, \quad y(\pi) = 0$$
द्वितीय न्यूनतम गैर-तुच्छ आइगेन-फलन (अर्थात $n = 2$) के संगत आइगेन-मान $\lambda$ ______ है (पूर्णांक में उत्तर दें)।
questions.explanationHi:
सीमांत प्रतिबंध $y(0) = 0$ तथा $y(\pi) = 0$ से:
$$\sin(\sqrt{\lambda} \pi) = 0 \implies \sqrt{\lambda} = n \implies \lambda = n^2$$
$n = 2$ के लिए $\lambda_2 = 2^2 = 4$।

questions.questionTextEn: A particle moves in a circular orbit of radius $R_0$ under an attractive central force $F(r) = -\frac{k}{r^n}$. For the circular orbit to be stable under small radial perturbations, the condition is $n < n_{\text{max}}$. The value of $n_{\text{max}}$ is ______ (answer in integer).
questions.explanationEn:
The effective potential for central force motion is:
$$V_{\text{eff}}(r) = V(r) + \frac{L^2}{2 m r^2}$$
where $F(r) = -\frac{dV}{dr} = -\frac{k}{r^n}$.
For a circular orbit at $r = R_0$:
$$V'_{\text{eff}}(R_0) = 0 \implies -F(R_0) - \frac{L^2}{m R_0^3} = 0 \implies \frac{L^2}{m R_0^3} = \frac{k}{R_0^n}$$
For stable small radial oscillations, we must have $V''_{\text{eff}}(R_0) > 0$:
$$V''_{\text{eff}}(r) = -F'(r) + \frac{3 L^2}{m r^4}$$
Evaluating at $r = R_0$:
$$F'(R_0) = \frac{d}{dr}\left(-\frac{k}{r^n}\right)_{R_0} = \frac{n k}{R_0^{n+1}}$$
$$V''_{\text{eff}}(R_0) = -\frac{n k}{R_0^{n+1}} + \frac{3}{R_0} \left( \frac{L^2}{m R_0^3} \right) = -\frac{n k}{R_0^{n+1}} + \frac{3}{R_0} \left( \frac{k}{R_0^n} \right) = \frac{k}{R_0^{n+1}} (3 - n)$$
For stability, $V''_{\text{eff}}(R_0) > 0 \implies 3 - n > 0 \implies n < 3$.
Thus, $n_{\text{max}} = 3$.
questions.questionTextHi: एक कण एक आकर्षक केंद्रीय बल $F(r) = -\frac{k}{r^n}$ के प्रभाव में त्रिज्या $R_0$ की वृत्ताकार कक्षा में गति करता है। अल्प त्रिज्यीय क्षोभों के तहत वृत्ताकार कक्षा के स्थायी होने के लिए शर्त $n < n_{\text{max}}$ है। $n_{\text{max}}$ का मान ______ है (पूर्णांक में उत्तर दें)।
questions.explanationHi:
प्रभावी विभव के स्थायित्व की शर्त $V''_{\text{eff}}(R_0) > 0$ से:
$$V''_{\text{eff}}(R_0) = \frac{k}{R_0^{n+1}}(3 - n) > 0 \implies n < 3$$
अतः $n_{\text{max}} = 3$।

questions.questionTextEn: A plane electromagnetic wave of frequency $f = 100\text{ MHz}$ propagates in copper having electrical conductivity $\sigma = 5.8 \times 10^7\,\Omega^{-1}\text{m}^{-1}$ and relative permeability $\mu_r = 1$ (take $\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}\text{ H/m}$). The skin depth $\delta$ in micrometers ($\,\mu\text{m}$, rounded off to one decimal place) is ______.
questions.explanationEn:
The skin depth in a good conductor is given by:
$$\delta = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\omega \mu \sigma}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi f \mu_0 \sigma}}$$
Given:
- $f = 100\text{ MHz} = 10^8\text{ Hz}$
- $\sigma = 5.8 \times 10^7\,\Omega^{-1}\text{m}^{-1}$
- $\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}\text{ H/m}$

Calculating the product under the square root:
$$\pi f \mu_0 \sigma = \pi \times 10^8 \times (4\pi \times 10^{-7}) \times (5.8 \times 10^7)$$
$$= 4 \pi^2 \times 10^1 \times 5.8 \times 10^7 = 4 \pi^2 \times 5.8 \times 10^8$$
Using $\pi^2 \approx 9.8696$:
$$4 \times 9.8696 \times 5.8 \approx 228.97$$
$$\pi f \mu_0 \sigma \approx 2.2897 \times 10^{10}\text{ m}^{-2}$$
Taking the square root:
$$\sqrt{\pi f \mu_0 \sigma} \approx 1.513 \times 10^5\text{ m}^{-1}$$
Then the skin depth is:
$$\delta = \frac{1}{1.513 \times 10^5} \approx 6.61 \times 10^{-6}\text{ m} = 6.61\,\mu\text{m}$$
Rounded off to one decimal place, $\delta = 6.6\,\mu\text{m}$.
questions.questionTextHi: तांबे (विद्युत चालकता $\sigma = 5.8 \times 10^7\,\Omega^{-1}\text{m}^{-1}$, आपेक्षिक पारगम्यता $\mu_r = 1$) में $f = 100\text{ MHz}$ आवृत्ति की एक विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग संचरित होती है। माइक्रोमीटर ($\mu\text{m}$, दशमलव के एक स्थान तक) में त्वचा गहराई (स्किन डेप्थ) $\delta$ ______ है।
questions.explanationHi:
अच्छे चालक में स्किन डेप्थ:
$$\delta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi f \mu_0 \sigma}}$$
$$\delta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\pi \times 10^8 \times 4\pi \times 10^{-7} \times 5.8 \times 10^7}} \approx 6.6\,\mu\text{m}$$

questions.questionTextEn: In the low-energy limit, the s-wave ($l = 0$) phase shift for scattering from a hard sphere of radius $a = 1.0\text{ fm}$ is given by $\delta_0 = -k a$. If all higher partial waves ($l \ge 1$) have negligible phase shifts, the total scattering cross-section $\sigma$ in $\text{fm}^2$ (rounded off to two decimal places) is ______ (take $\pi = 3.1416$).
questions.explanationEn:
In partial wave analysis, the total scattering cross-section is:
$$\sigma = \frac{4\pi}{k^2} \sum_{l=0}^\infty (2l + 1) \sin^2 \delta_l$$
For low energy ($k a \ll 1$), only the $s$-wave ($l = 0$) contributes:
$$\sin \delta_0 = \sin(-k a) \approx -k a$$
$$\sin^2 \delta_0 \approx k^2 a^2$$
Substituting this into the cross-section formula:
$$\sigma = \frac{4\pi}{k^2} \sin^2 \delta_0 = \frac{4\pi}{k^2} (k^2 a^2) = 4\pi a^2$$
Given $a = 1.0\text{ fm}$:
$$\sigma = 4 \times 3.1416 \times (1.0)^2 = 12.5664\text{ fm}^2 \approx 12.57\text{ fm}^2$$
questions.questionTextHi: निम्न-ऊर्जा सीमा में, त्रिज्या $a = 1.0\text{ fm}$ वाले एक दृढ़ गोले से प्रकीर्णन के लिए $s$-तरंग ($l = 0$) कला विस्थापन $\delta_0 = -k a$ है। यदि सभी उच्च आंशिक तरंगों ($l \ge 1$) के कला विस्थापन नगण्य हैं, तो $\text{fm}^2$ में कुल प्रकीर्णन अनुप्रस्थ-काट $\sigma$ (दशमलव के दो स्थानों तक) ______ है ($\pi = 3.1416$ लें)।
questions.explanationHi:
निम्न ऊर्जा सीमा में दृढ़ गोले के लिए कुल प्रकीर्णन अनुप्रस्थ काट:
$$\sigma = 4\pi a^2 = 4 \times 3.1416 \times (1.0)^2 \approx 12.57\text{ fm}^2$$

questions.questionTextEn: A spherical blackbody of radius $R_1 = 10\text{ cm}$ at temperature $T_1 = 2000\text{ K}$ radiates total power $P_1$. A second spherical blackbody of the same radius $R_2 = 10\text{ cm}$ is at temperature $T_2 = 1000\text{ K}$ and radiates total power $P_2$. The ratio $\frac{P_1}{P_2}$ is ______ (answer in integer).
questions.explanationEn:
By the Stefan-Boltzmann law, the total radiated power of a spherical blackbody of radius $R$ at temperature $T$ is:
$$P = \sigma A T^4 = \sigma (4\pi R^2) T^4$$
Taking the ratio of $P_1$ to $P_2$:
$$\frac{P_1}{P_2} = \left( \frac{R_1}{R_2} \right)^2 \left( \frac{T_1}{T_2} \right)^4$$
Given:
$$\frac{R_1}{R_2} = \frac{10}{20} = \frac{1}{2}$$
$$\frac{T_1}{T_2} = \frac{2000}{1000} = 2$$
Therefore:
$$\frac{P_1}{P_2} = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 (2)^4 = \frac{1}{4} \times 16 = 4$$
Wait! Let's re-calculate:
$(1/2)^2 = 1/4$.
$2^4 = 16$.
$16 / 4 = 4$!
Wait, if $R_1 = 20\text{ cm}$ and $R_2 = 10\text{ cm}$, then $(2)^2 \times 2^4 = 4 \times 16 = 64$.
Let's check: $(1/2)^2 \times (2)^4 = 4$.
Let's make the numbers give 16 if we want answer to be 16:
If $R_1 = R_2$, then $(T_1/T_2)^4 = 2^4 = 16$!
Or if $R_1 = 10\text{ cm}$, $R_2 = 10\text{ cm}$ (identical radii):
then $P_1 / P_2 = (2000/1000)^4 = 16$!
Let's set $R_1 = 10\text{ cm}$ and $R_2 = 10\text{ cm}$, or $R_1 = 20\text{ cm}, R_2 = 10\text{ cm}, T_1 = 2000\text{ K}, T_2 = 2000\text{ K}$:
Let's use: $R_1 = 10\text{ cm}$ at $T_1 = 2000\text{ K}$, and $R_2 = 10\text{ cm}$ at $T_2 = 1000\text{ K}$:
$$\frac{P_1}{P_2} = \left(\frac{2000}{1000}\right)^4 = 16$$
questions.questionTextHi: त्रिज्या $R_1 = 10\text{ cm}$ की एक गोलाकार कृष्णिका (ब्लैकबॉडी) तापमान $T_1 = 2000\text{ K}$ पर कुल शक्ति $P_1$ विकीर्ण करती है। समान त्रिज्या $R_2 = 10\text{ cm}$ की दूसरी गोलाकार कृष्णिका तापमान $T_2 = 1000\text{ K}$ पर कुल शक्ति $P_2$ विकीर्ण करती है। अनुपात $\frac{P_1}{P_2}$ का मान ______ है (पूर्णांक में उत्तर दें)।
questions.explanationHi:
स्टीफन-बोल्ट्ज़मान नियम से $P = 4\pi R^2 \sigma T^4$:
समान त्रिज्या के लिए:
$$\frac{P_1}{P_2} = \left(\frac{T_1}{T_2}\right)^4 = \left(\frac{2000}{1000}\right)^4 = 2^4 = 16$$

questions.questionTextEn: In a singly ionized helium atom ($	ext{He}^+$, $Z = 2$), the energy required to excite an electron from the $n = 1$ ground state to the $n = 2$ first excited state is ______ eV (rounded off to one decimal place). (Rydberg energy for hydrogen is $13.6\text{ eV}$).
questions.explanationEn:
For a hydrogen-like ion with atomic number $Z$, the energy levels are given by:
$$E_n = -13.6 \frac{Z^2}{n^2} \, \text{eV}$$
For $\text{He}^+$, $Z = 2$:
$$E_n = -13.6 \times \frac{4}{n^2} = -\frac{54.4}{n^2} \, \text{eV}$$
For the ground state ($n = 1$):
$$E_1 = -54.4\text{ eV}$$
For the first excited state ($n = 2$):
$$E_2 = -\frac{54.4}{4} = -13.6\text{ eV}$$
The excitation energy is:
$$\Delta E = E_2 - E_1 = -13.6 - (-54.4) = 54.4 - 13.6 = 40.8\text{ eV}$$
Wait! $54.4 - 13.6 = 40.8\text{ eV}$! Let's check: $13.6 \times 4 \times (1 - 1/4) = 13.6 \times 3 = 40.8\text{ eV}$.
Yes, $40.8\text{ eV}$!
Let's set correctOption to 40.8.
questions.questionTextHi: एकल आयनित हीलियम परमाणु ($	ext{He}^+$, $Z = 2$) में इलेक्ट्रॉन को $n = 1$ मूल अवस्था से $n = 2$ प्रथम उत्तेजित अवस्था में उत्तेजित करने के लिए आवश्यक ऊर्जा ______ eV है (दशमलव के एक स्थान तक)। (हाइड्रोजन के लिए रिडबर्ग ऊर्जा $13.6\text{ eV}$ लें)।
questions.explanationHi:
हाइड्रोजन-सदृश आयन के लिए ऊर्जा स्तर:
$$E_n = -13.6 \frac{Z^2}{n^2}\text{ eV}$$
$\text{He}^+$ ($Z = 2$) के लिए:
$$\Delta E = 13.6 \times 2^2 \left(1 - \frac{1}{4}\right) = 13.6 \times 4 \times \frac{3}{4} = 40.8\text{ eV}$$

questions.questionTextEn: At very low temperatures ($T \ll \Theta_D$), the lattice heat capacity of a three-dimensional crystalline solid follows the Debye $T^3$ law: $C_V = A T^3$. If the temperature of the crystal is doubled from $T = 2\text{ K}$ to $T = 4\text{ K}$, the lattice heat capacity increases by a factor of ______ (answer in integer).
questions.explanationEn:
According to the Debye model for low temperatures:
$$C_V \propto T^3$$
If the temperature is increased from $T_1 = 2\text{ K}$ to $T_2 = 4\text{ K}$, the temperature increases by a factor of:
$$\frac{T_2}{T_1} = \frac{4}{2} = 2$$
The lattice heat capacity increases by the factor:
$$\frac{C_V(T_2)}{C_V(T_1)} = \left( \frac{T_2}{T_1} \right)^3 = 2^3 = 8$$
Thus, the answer is 8.
questions.questionTextHi: अत्यंत निम्न ताप ($T \ll \Theta_D$) पर एक त्रि-विमीय क्रिस्टलीय ठोस की जालक ऊष्मा धारिता देबाई $T^3$ नियम का पालन करती है: $C_V = A T^3$। यदि क्रिस्टल का ताप $T = 2\text{ K}$ से दोगुना करके $T = 4\text{ K}$ कर दिया जाए, तो जालक ऊष्मा धारिता कितने गुना बढ़ जाएगी? ______ (पूर्णांक में उत्तर दें)।
questions.explanationHi:
देबाई नियम से $C_V \propto T^3$:
ताप दोगुना करने पर:
$$\frac{C_V(4\text{ K})}{C_V(2\text{ K})} = \left(\frac{4}{2}\right)^3 = 2^3 = 8$$

questions.questionTextEn: A common-emitter BJT amplifier circuit has load collector resistance $R_C = 2\text{ k}\Omega$ and transconductance $g_m = 50\text{ mS}$ (millisiemens). Neglecting the Early effect (internal output resistance $r_0 \to \infty$), the magnitude of the small-signal midband voltage gain $|A_v| = |v_{\text{out}} / v_{\text{in}}|$ is ______ (answer in integer).
questions.explanationEn:
For a common-emitter amplifier without emitter degeneration, the small-signal voltage gain is:
$$A_v = -g_m (R_C \parallel r_0)$$
With $r_0 \to \infty$:
$$A_v = -g_m R_C$$
Given:
- $g_m = 50\text{ mS} = 50 \times 10^{-3}\text{ S} = 0.05\,\Omega^{-1}$
- $R_C = 2\text{ k}\Omega = 2000\,\Omega$

The magnitude of the voltage gain is:
$$|A_v| = g_m R_C = 0.05 \times 2000 = 100$$
Thus, the answer is 100.
questions.questionTextHi: एक उभयनिष्ठ-उत्सर्जक (CE) BJT प्रवर्धक परिपथ में संग्राहक लोड प्रतिरोध $R_C = 2\text{ k}\Omega$ तथा ट्रांसकंडक्टेंस $g_m = 50\text{ mS}$ (मिलीसीमेंस) है। अर्ली प्रभाव को नगण्य मानते हुए ($r_0 \to \infty$), अल्प-संकेत मध्य-बैंड वोल्टता लब्धि का परिमाण $|A_v|$ ______ है (पूर्णांक में उत्तर दें)।
questions.explanationHi:
उभयनिष्ठ उत्सर्जक प्रवर्धक की वोल्टता लब्धि:
$$|A_v| = g_m R_C = (50 \times 10^{-3}\text{ S}) \times (2000\,\Omega) = 100$$

questions.questionTextEn:
Consider the nuclear reaction:
$$^2_1\text{H} + ^3_1\text{H} \to ^4_2\text{He} + ^1_0\text{n}$$
Given the atomic mass excesses ($\Delta = M - A$ in MeV):
- $\Delta(^2_1\text{H}) = +13.136\text{ MeV}$
- $\Delta(^3_1\text{H}) = +14.950\text{ MeV}$
- $\Delta(^4_2\text{He}) = +2.425\text{ MeV}$
- $\Delta(^1_0\text{n}) = +8.071\text{ MeV}$
The $Q$-value of the reaction in MeV (rounded off to two decimal places) is ______.
questions.explanationEn:
The $Q$-value of a nuclear reaction $A + B \to C + D$ expressed in terms of mass excesses is:
$$Q = [\Delta(A) + \Delta(B)] - [\Delta(C) + \Delta(D)]$$
Substituting the given values:
$$\Delta(^2_1\text{H}) + \Delta(^3_1\text{H}) = 13.136 + 14.950 = 28.086\text{ MeV}$$
$$\Delta(^4_2\text{He}) + \Delta(^1_0\text{n}) = 2.425 + 8.071 = 10.496\text{ MeV}$$
Subtracting:
$$Q = 28.086 - 10.496 = 17.590\text{ MeV}$$
Wait! $28.086 - 10.496 = 17.590\text{ MeV}$!
Let's check: $17.59\text{ MeV}$ is the exact well-known D-T fusion $Q$-value!
Let's update correctOption to 17.59.

$$^2_1\text{H} + ^3_1\text{H} \to ^4_2\text{He} + ^1_0\text{n}$$
दिए गए परमाणु द्रव्यमान आधिक्य (MeV में):
- $\Delta(^2_1\text{H}) = +13.136\text{ MeV}$
- $\Delta(^3_1\text{H}) = +14.950\text{ MeV}$
- $\Delta(^4_2\text{He}) = +2.425\text{ MeV}$

अभिक्रिया का $Q$-मान MeV में (दशमलव के दो स्थानों तक) ______ है।

questions.questionTextEn: A relativistic particle of rest mass $m_0$ has kinetic energy $T = m_0 c^2$ (equal to its rest mass energy). The magnitude of its relativistic momentum $p$ in units of $m_0 c$ (i.e. $\frac{p}{m_0 c}$, rounded off to two decimal places) is ______ (take $\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732$).
questions.explanationEn:
The total relativistic energy is:
$$E = T + m_0 c^2 = m_0 c^2 + m_0 c^2 = 2 m_0 c^2$$
The relativistic energy-momentum relation is:
$$E^2 = p^2 c^2 + m_0^2 c^4$$
Substituting $E = 2 m_0 c^2$:
$$(2 m_0 c^2)^2 = p^2 c^2 + m_0^2 c^4$$
$$4 m_0^2 c^4 = p^2 c^2 + m_0^2 c^4$$
$$p^2 c^2 = 3 m_0^2 c^4$$
$$p = \sqrt{3} m_0 c$$
Thus, the momentum in units of $m_0 c$ is:
$$\frac{p}{m_0 c} = \sqrt{3} \approx 1.732$$
Rounded off to two decimal places, the value is 1.73.
questions.questionTextHi: विराम द्रव्यमान $m_0$ के एक आपेक्षिकीय कण की गतिज ऊर्जा $T = m_0 c^2$ (इसकी विराम द्रव्यमान ऊर्जा के बराबर) है। $m_0 c$ के मात्रक में इसके आपेक्षिकीय संवेग का परिमाण $\frac{p}{m_0 c}$ (दशमलव के दो स्थानों तक) ______ है ($\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732$ लें)।
questions.explanationHi:
कुल आपेक्षिकीय ऊर्जा:
$$E = T + m_0 c^2 = 2 m_0 c^2$$
ऊर्जा-संवेग संबंध:
$$E^2 = p^2 c^2 + m_0^2 c^4 \implies (2m_0 c^2)^2 = p^2 c^2 + m_0^2 c^4$$
$$p^2 c^2 = 3 m_0^2 c^4 \implies p = \sqrt{3} m_0 c \approx 1.73 m_0 c$$
